notes: Factory interval annual / 10,000 mi for both eras (987.1 M96/M97 and 987.2 9A1 DFI). Given the cars' age most owners shorten to 5,000-7,500 mi. Use Porsche A40-approved 0W-40.
The general annual service (minor/'A' service). Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2 model years. Intervals are cumulative - the 2yr/4yr services include the annual items.
Every 2 years regardless of mileage (fluid is hygroscopic). All 987.1/987.2, manual/Tiptronic/PDK. Use DOT 4 (later cars DOT 4 Low Viscosity).
Inspect pad and rotor wear at each annual service; replace on wear. Applies to all 987 years.
Part of the minor/intermediate (2yr) service. Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.
Part of the 2yr service. Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.

987.1 only (M96/M97, 2005-2008). Six plugs. Commonly cited as 4yr/40k; some sources/owners cite the earlier 987.1 figure as 36k mi - treat exact mileage as MEDIUM confidence, but the 4-year time limit is firm. Replace even on low-mileage cars to avoid seizing in the alloy head.
987.2 only (9A1 DFI, 2009-2012). Six plugs. Factory 4yr / 40,000 mi. DFI engines are sensitive to plug condition (cold-start/misfire), so keep to the 4-year limit even at low mileage.
Inspect spark-plug tube seals for oil seepage whenever plugs are changed (~4yr/40k). Weeping seals are common on M96/M97 (987.1). Applies to all 987; inspection only, replace on leakage.

No factory drain/refill interval - Porsche G40 is a lifetime fill. Inspect condition/level at each service; common owner practice is a fresh drain-and-refill every ~4-6 years (interval shown is that owner practice, LOW confidence as factory value). System must be vacuum-filled / properly bled to avoid air pockets. Use G40 (silicate-free).
Inspect at each service; replace around 6yr / 60k. Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.
At about 6yr / 60k. Applies to all 987 years.

Manual cars only (both 987.1 and 987.2). Factory 12yr / 120k. The mid-engine transaxle integrates the differential, so this one fill covers the diff - there is no separate diff service on manual cars. Use 75W-90 GL-5. Many owners change earlier (~60k).
Manual cars only. The hydraulic clutch shares the brake reservoir / DOT 4 fluid and is bled during the 2-year brake fluid flush - no separate interval.

task: Tiptronic S automatic transmission fluid (ATF) service
notes: 987.1 Tiptronic S only (ZF 5HP19 5-speed auto, 2005-2008). Porsche officially calls this a lifetime/'fill-for-life' fluid (no scheduled change), which is heavily debated - specialists and owners strongly recommend servicing every ~4-6yr / 40-60k (interval shown reflects that recommendation, MEDIUM confidence; there is NO firm factory mileage). A drain-and-fill only recovers ~3.5 L because the torque converter retains the rest. Use ZF Lifeguard 5 ATF.

987.1 Tiptronic only. On the auto the final drive is SEPARATE from the ATF (~0.8 L of 75W-90). There is no drain plug - old oil is suctioned out and refilled via the fill plug. No official interval; service alongside the ATF (LOW confidence on interval).

987.2 PDK only (2009-2012). Factory PDK gear oil + filter interval is 12yr / 120k, but specialists and owners strongly recommend ~40k / 4yr to protect the Mechatronic unit. Requires PIWIS-guided fill procedure.
987.2 PDK only. Separate from the PDK gear oil. Factory cadence 6yr / 60k; many specialists do it earlier (~40k) with the transmission service. Requires PIWIS fill mode.

No fixed interval. Check for the latest Porsche PIWIS transmission software / applicable TSBs at major services - updates can resolve PDK shift-quality and Tiptronic adaptation complaints. 987.2 PDK and 987.1 Tiptronic. LOW confidence (as-needed, not a scheduled item).

task: DFI fuel-system check (no serviceable fuel filter)
notes: 987.2 9A1 DFI only. There is NO scheduled/serviceable fuel filter - the filter is integrated in the in-tank pump module (lifetime). The camshaft-driven high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) is a known wear item; not a scheduled service, but inspect if you see rough hot-starts, misfires or fuel-trim/pressure faults. LOW confidence (condition-based, not interval-based).

Inspect tread, age (replace ~6yr regardless of tread) and pressures at every service. All 987 run staggered fitment, so front-to-rear rotation is not possible; rotate side-to-side only if directional pattern allows.
987 ships with a tyre mobility (sealant) kit instead of a spare. The sealant bottle expires and is a listed replacement item at ~4yr / 40k. All 987 years.
Load/CCA-tested at each annual service. All 987 years. A trickle/maintenance charger is recommended for low-use cars.

No fixed factory A/C service interval. Operation and vent temperature are checked at scheduled services; recharge R134a and service the receiver/drier only as needed (interval shown is a practical check cadence, LOW confidence). All 987 years.
